name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: A researcher-in-a-box that reads what real people are actually saying across Reddit, X, YouTube, and betting markets about any topic, then writes you an honest summary of what's really going on.
buyer: A boutique market-research consultant or newsletter writer who gets paid to tell clients 'what's actually happening right now' on a topic, without manually doom-scrolling five platforms.
business_use_cases: A market-research consultancy sells clients a recurring 'what the internet actually thinks about X this month' report, built automatically with this skill.
A VC analyst runs a quick sanity-check on an emerging narrative before a pitch meeting instead of spending an afternoon manually trawling forums.
A niche newsletter writer automates a weekly 'what's trending' column, freeing up hours previously spent manually reading Reddit and X threads.

money_ideas.idea: Paid subscription newsletter or report service built on automated trend research
One-off custom research reports sold to brand or PR agencies ahead of a campaign

steal_this: Pick one niche (e.g. a specific hobby or B2B industry), run this skill weekly, and launch a $15/month 'what's actually trending in X' newsletter before building anything else.
